policies.anonymous-engineering-reader: permit(principal is Registry::Principal, action == Registry::Action::"catalog.read", resource == Registry::View::"engineering") when { !principal.authenticated };
policies.forbid-anonymous: permit(principal, action, resource); forbid(principal, action, resource) when { !principal.authenticated };
policies.ill-typed: permit(principal, action, resource); permit(principal, action, resource) when { principal.missing == true };
